meta.name: ml-training-recipes
meta.description: Battle-tested PyTorch training recipes for all domains — LLMs, vision, diffusion, medical imaging, protein/drug discovery, spatial omics, genomics. Covers training loops, optimizer selection (AdamW, Muon), LR scheduling, mixed precision, debugging, and systematic experimentation. Use when training or fine-tuning neural networks, debugging loss spikes or OOM, choosing architectures, or optimizing GPU throughput.

copy.tagline_en: Train and fine-tune neural networks with battle-tested recipes

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能提供 PyTorch 模型训练的全套方案，包括架构选择、优化器配置、学习率调度、混合精度训练、内存优化、超参数调优和调试检查清单。
howto.when: 当你询问如何训练或微调神经网络、调试损失爆炸或显存溢出、选择模型架构或优化 GPU 吞吐量时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一个 PyTorch 训练循环，使用 bf16 混合精度。
say.note: Claude 会给出包含梯度累积和自动混合精度的训练代码。

say.text: 训练 7B 模型时，学习率应该设多少？
say.note: Claude 会参考缩放法则和默认配方给出建议。

say.text: 我的损失值突然变成 NaN，怎么排查？
say.note: Claude 会按调试清单逐步指导。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can provide complete PyTorch training recipes including architecture selection, optimizer configuration, LR scheduling, mixed precision, memory optimization, hyperparameter tuning, and debugging checklists.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about training or fine-tuning neural networks, debugging loss spikes or OOM, choosing architectures, or optimizing GPU throughput.

say_en.text: Write a PyTorch training loop with bf16 mixed precision.
say_en.note: Claude will output code with gradient accumulation and autocast.

say_en.text: What learning rate should I use for a 7B model?
say_en.note: Claude will reference scaling laws and default recipe.

say_en.text: My loss suddenly became NaN, how to debug?
say_en.note: Claude will follow the debugging checklist step by step.
